cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

# ============================================================================
# Turok: Evolution (Xbox, USA, title 0x41430004) - static recompilation
#
# Layout:
#   tools/xboxrecomp/      the recompiler + runtime libraries (git submodule)
#   src/main.c             host entry point (loads default.xbe, boots guest)
#   src/recomp_manual.c    hand-written overrides / ICALL diagnostics
#   src/recomp/gen/*.c     lifted C (generated by scripts/recomp.ps1, gitignored)
#
# Nothing from the game disc is in this tree (BYOG). Extract your own disc
# with scripts/extract-disc.ps1; ./game points at it.
# ============================================================================

project(turok_recomp VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

if(WIN32)
    add_compile_definitions(WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN NOMINMAX)
endif()

set(XBOXRECOMP_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/xboxrecomp" CACHE PATH
    "Path to the xboxrecomp toolkit root directory")

if(NOT EXISTS "${XBOXRECOMP_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "xboxrecomp submodule missing. Run: git submodule update --init --recursive")
endif()

# The toolkit hard-codes /O2 on its kernel library, which MSVC refuses to
# combine with the /RTC1 checks CMake adds to Debug.
if(MSVC)
    string(REPLACE "/RTC1" "" CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS_DEBUG}")
endif()

option(TUROK_ABI_CHECK "Check callee-saved registers across every lifted call" OFF)
if(TUROK_ABI_CHECK)
    add_compile_definitions(RECOMP_ABI_CHECK=1)
endif()

add_subdirectory(${XBOXRECOMP_DIR} ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/xboxrecomp)

file(GLOB RECOMP_GEN_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "src/recomp/gen/*.c")

option(TUROK_BUILD_GAME "Build the game executable (requires src/recomp/gen from scripts/recomp.ps1)" ON)
if(TUROK_BUILD_GAME AND NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/recomp/gen/recomp_dispatch.c")
    message(WARNING "src/recomp/gen is empty - run scripts/analyze.ps1 and scripts/recomp.ps1. Building runtime libraries only.")
    set(TUROK_BUILD_GAME OFF)
endif()

if(TUROK_BUILD_GAME)
    add_executable(${PROJECT_NAME} WIN32
        src/main.c
        src/recomp_manual.c
        ${RECOMP_GEN_SOURCES}
    )
    target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE xboxrecomp
        d3d11 dxgi dxguid
        $<IF:$<BOOL:${MINGW}>,xinput1_4,xinput>
        winmm dbghelp)
    target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/recomp
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/recomp/gen
        ${XBOXRECOMP_DIR}/include
    )
    target_compile_definitions(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE TUROK_VERSION=\"${PROJECT_VERSION}\")
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE /bigobj /Zi)
        # /DEBUG keeps the PDB so the VEH handler names guest functions.
        # /MAP + /DYNAMICBASE:NO: a crash RIP is a map address, stable across runs.
        # /OPT:NOICF: identical lifted bodies are not folded, so crashes name the right function.
        # /INCREMENTAL:NO: link.exe's incremental linker can crash on images this large (LNK1000).
        target_link_options(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE /LARGEADDRESSAWARE /DEBUG /INCREMENTAL:NO
            /MAP:${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/turok_recomp.map /DYNAMICBASE:NO /OPT:NOICF)
    endif()
    option(TUROK_ICALL_TRACE "Trace indirect calls (slow, verbose)" OFF)
    option(TUROK_VERBOSE_KERNEL "Log every kernel call" OFF)
    if(TUROK_ICALL_TRACE)
        target_compile_definitions(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE ENABLE_ICALL_TRACE=1)
    endif()
    if(TUROK_VERBOSE_KERNEL)
        target_compile_definitions(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE VERBOSE_KERNEL_LOG=1)
    endif()
endif()
